Container.Name: Tagwerk
Container.Overview: Self-hosted music library manager: library dashboard, DJ and Collector modes (BPM, keys, labels / albums, years, lyrics), tag editing (MP3, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, M4A, OGG, Opus), metadata lookup and Navidrome integration. Changes are reviewed before they are written to your files.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Your music share, e.g. /mnt/user/music. Use the same folder your Navidrome container uses. Read-write so tags can be edited.

Config.Name: Import Inbox
Config.Description: Optional. Folder for new music (downloads, record pools, promos), e.g. /mnt/user/music-inbox. Tagwerk tags these tracks and moves them into the library. Use a folder outside your music share, so Navidrome doesn't show unfinished tracks.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database and settings. Keep appdata on a pool (exclusive share) so SQLite works reliably.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Optional. Navidrome's address, so Tagwerk can ask it to rescan after changing files, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4533 (your server's IP), or http://navidrome:4533 if both containers share a custom Docker network. Not localhost.

Config.Name: Navidrome User
Config.Description: Optional. A Navidrome user with admin rights (needed to start scans).

Config.Name: Navidrome Password
Config.Description: Optional. That user's password. Sent to Navidrome only as a salted token.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for newly created files.
